items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Various clipping fixes in Rush maps. Fixed visualization of weapon inaccuracy + spread. Added crosshair outline color option. Added a new style "Static Quadrant"Enabled grenade crosshairs in freeze time for insta-smokes (just hold any grenade attack button)Allowed negative gaps for classic dynamic crosshair style. Changed the classic dynamic crosshair alpha increments to 0. 01Scope dot scale and color preferences are now included in the new crosshair share code. Changed the format of the crosshair share code to accommodate newly included crosshair settings

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Fixed pixel-gaps in various Rush rooms. Clipping adjustments in T/CT Castle rooms

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Various gap fixes and clipping adjustments.. Fixed some cases where loud reloads would persist while trying to stealth reload.. Added sv_clantags_enabled option so custom servers can disable clan tags. The eggs of background players in main menu lobbies now rest in nests

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Added a better description of the rules to the loading screen. Adjusted rules for determining when to kick players due to team damage. Various clipping adjustments.. Fixed a case where it was possible to get a slightly faster silent reload by tapping the reload button before holding it. Fixed a case where it was possible to use silent reload to fire shotguns faster than normal.. Fixed a case where the AK-47 inspect animation sometimes popped

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Increased the maximum countdown-after-elimination time from 7 seconds to 14 seconds on end rooms and Convoy. The countdown-after-elimination time does not activate in cases where an entire team dies to suicides, team kills, and/or disconnects. Warmup time once all players have connected, freeze time, and technical timeout time are all reduced. Various gap fixes and clipping adjustments. Some additional information about the new crosshair system: The new crosshair thickness and length units are in pixels.
